evals.prompt: Use the openrpc-linter skill to fix the lint failure in openrpc.json using the existing rules.yml. The ping method returns pong.
evals.expected_output: The ping method has an accurate, non-empty description and the document passes lint with the original rules.
expectations: The agent runs openrpc-linter against the document with the existing rules.yml.
The ping method remains present and gains a description consistent with returning pong; unrelated document fields are preserved.
A final lint run against the original rules exits successfully.

setup: See README.md for the local runner. It supplies only the skill and task to the agent. File and lint checks are automatic; CLI usage and description accuracy are reviewed in agent.log.
